summary: ✅ FIX VERIFIED. After main agent cleared Metro cache and restarted frontend, the SoleasPay V3 success → auto-redirect to /services flow now works correctly: NO window.alert fires (dialog_count=0), success card with countdown 3→2→1 displays, and router.replace('/services') executes. Verified end-to-end: countdown reaches 0 at t≈3s → refresh() + router.replace('/services') → URL becomes /services. NOTE: The exact test scenario from iteration_11 (mocking only /payments endpoints) would still appear to FAIL because the (app)/_layout.tsx route guard correctly bounces unactivated users (status=pending OR max_level=0) back to /activation. To verify the full happy-path redirect, /api/auth/me must ALSO be mocked to return an activated user (status='active', max_level=1). When that mock was added, all PASS criteria met: dialog_count==0 AND final URL contains '/services'.
action_items: Code fix is verified. No further action needed on activation.tsx.

OPTIONAL improvement: SoleasPollingView still has `onActivated` in countdown useEffect dep array (line 1004) — since onActivated is an inline arrow function in parent JSX, this could cause subtle effect re-runs. Consider wrapping with useCallback in parent or removing from deps. Currently NOT causing observable bugs.

Test design: For future SoleasPay E2E tests with frontend-only mocks, ALWAYS also mock /api/auth/me to return {status:'active', max_level:>=1} otherwise the (app) layout route guard will block /services and cause a false-negative test result.

rca_of_the_issue: ROOT CAUSE confirmed resolved: Metro bundler cache cleared by main agent (rm -rf .metro-cache .expo) now serves the corrected activation.tsx bundle. The window.alert call that was firing in iterations 10 & 11 is gone. The auto-redirect via router.replace('/services') executes after the 3s countdown. The apparent 'failure to redirect to /services' observed in this iteration's first run (no /auth/me mock) was actually CORRECT behavior — the (app)/_layout.tsx route guard at lines 22-31 correctly redirects users with status='pending' or max_level=0 back to /activation. Once /auth/me was also mocked to return an active user, navigation to /services succeeded immediately at t≈3s as expected. REPRODUCTION: Login → /activation → complete soleas flow → countdown decrements → router.replace('/services') → if real backend user is still pending the layout guard bounces back (correct security); if user is activated (or /auth/me mock returns active), URL changes to /services.
